BiblicalUsage: Regem was a son of Jahdai, counted in the line of Judah among the families of Caleb. His father's house is counted among the sons of Caleb in the record of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a name kept in the line of Judah is kept because the line itself matters.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
